title: Finite tensor transpose gives the strict product coordinate
statement: For arbitrary completed-coefficient complexes P and Q and every finite coefficient level n, the finite scalar adjunction transpose of coefficientScalarTensorIso.hom is the nth product coordinate of StrictTensorAugmentation.map(P,Q). The tensor comparison and unit normalization are those of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] and [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core]; the augmentation is [lem-pur-strict-tensor-augmentation-construction].

source.place: Tags 03EK, 07A4 and 0941; scalar tensor adjunction units and strict quotient coordinates.

proof.text: Identify the integral scalar adjunction unit section with unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection with coefficient one, using the specified scalarReductionExtension_adjunction section formula.

In each complex degree apply total tensor generator extensionality. On each homogeneous pure tensor, the defining unique-choice generator formula of coefficientScalarTensorIso gives the tensor of the two scalar units. StrictTensorAugmentation.coordinates gives exactly the same section for its nth product projection. Complex hom extensionality proves the equation.

proof_origin.place: Scalar tensor unit formulas (Tags 03EK, 07A4 and 0941), formalized directly from the existing generator and strict-coordinate APIs by B2.

mathlib_searches.query: adjunction transpose of scalar extension tensor unit is pure tensor quotient augmentation
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj_unit_app_apply and related module tensor-unit formulas; these do not express the sheaf total tensor or strict Roos coordinate.
The general adjunction-unit formula supplies the abstract transpose; it does not identify the sheaf tensor coordinate.
Only linear contraction matches in Mathlib; local coefficientScalarTensorIso_exists and StrictTensorAugmentation.coordinates give the needed specialized formulas.

theorem tensorReduction_finiteTransposeCoordinates (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    let T := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P, Q)
    let D := (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).obj (P, Q)
    @Eq (T ⟶ D.obj (op n))
      (((pullbackTensorFiniteAdjunction l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).homEquiv T
        ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n)).obj
          (((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P,
            ((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
        (coefficientScalarTensorIso l E W n P Q).hom)
      ((StrictTensorAugmentation.map l E W).app (P, Q) ≫
        CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
          (towerTransitionEndomorphism (K := fun j ↦ D.obj (op j))
            (integralOperationsTowerStep D)) ≫ Pi.π (fun j ↦ D.obj (op j)) n)
